name: alb_ice
description: albedo of ice (only used if albedo is not prescribed by the forcing)

name: alb_snow
description: albedo of snow (only used if albedo is not prescribed by the forcing)

name: es
description: ratio of the molar masses of water vapour and dry air (epsilon)

name: es_0
description: saturation vapour pressure at the melting point

name: es_100
description: saturation vapour pressure at the steam point temperature

name: em
description: longwave surface emissivity

name: ext_air
description: extinction coefficient of shortwave radiation in air for clear-sky conditions

name: ext_air_cl
description: cloud-dependent add-on to the extinction coefficient of shortwave radiation in air

name: ext_ice
description: extinction coefficient of shortwave radiation in ice (no penetration if set to 1e10)

name: ext_snow
description: extinction coefficient of shortwave radiation in snow (no penetration if set to 1e10)

name: g
description: gravitational acceleration at sea level (80 N: 9.83; 60 N: 9.82)

name: gamma
description: flux-profile correction constant for unstable conditions (Paulson 1970; Dyer 1974)

name: kappa
description: von Karman constant (0.35-0.42)

name: L_sub
description: latent heat of sublimation

name: L_fus
description: latent heat of fusion

name: L_vap
description: latent heat of vaporization

name: R_d
description: gas constant of dry air

name: R_v
description: gas constant of water vapour

name: rho_ice
description: density of ice

name: rho_snow
description: density of snow

name: rho_water
description: density of water at the melting point

name: rh2oice
description: ratio rho_water / rho_ice

name: sigma
description: Stefan-Boltzmann constant

name: T_solidprecip
description: near-surface temperature below which precipitation is solid

name: T_0
description: melting point temperature

name: T_100
description: steam point temperature

name: z0_ice
description: surface roughness length for ice (Lefebre et al. 2003)

name: z0_fresh_snow
description: surface roughness length for fresh snow (Lefebre et al. 2003)

name: z0_old_snow
description: surface roughness length for old snow (Lefebre et al. 2003)

name: aa
description: stable flux-profile correction constant a (Holtslag & De Bruin 1988)

name: bb
description: stable flux-profile correction constant b (Holtslag & De Bruin 1988)

name: cc
description: stable flux-profile correction constant c (Holtslag & De Bruin 1988)

name: dd
description: stable flux-profile correction constant d (Holtslag & De Bruin 1988)

name: beta
description: legacy constant from the original SEB code (not used in the Python version)

name: c_pd
description: specific heat of dry air

name: c_w
description: specific heat of water at 0 degC (www.engineeringtoolbox.com)

name: k_water
description: thermal conductivity of liquid water at 0 degC

name: ch1_low_Re
description: coefficient 1 of the roughness length for heat z_h over smooth surfaces for Re <= 0.135 (Andreas 1987)

name: ch1_mid_Re
description: coefficient 1 of the roughness length for heat z_h over smooth surfaces for 0.135 < Re < 2.5 (Andreas 1987)

name: ch1_high_Re
description: coefficient 1 of the roughness length for heat z_h over smooth surfaces for Re >= 2.5 (Andreas 1987)

name: ch2_low_Re
description: coefficient 2 of the roughness length for heat z_h over smooth surfaces for Re <= 0.135 (Andreas 1987)

name: ch2_mid_Re
description: coefficient 2 of the roughness length for heat z_h over smooth surfaces for 0.135 < Re < 2.5 (Andreas 1987)

name: ch2_high_Re
description: coefficient 2 of the roughness length for heat z_h over smooth surfaces for Re >= 2.5 (Andreas 1987)

name: ch3_low_Re
description: coefficient 3 of the roughness length for heat z_h over smooth surfaces for Re <= 0.135 (Andreas 1987)

name: ch3_mid_Re
description: coefficient 3 of the roughness length for heat z_h over smooth surfaces for 0.135 < Re < 2.5 (Andreas 1987)

name: ch3_high_Re
description: coefficient 3 of the roughness length for heat z_h over smooth surfaces for Re >= 2.5 (Andreas 1987)

name: cq1_low_Re
description: coefficient 1 of the roughness length for moisture z_q over smooth surfaces for Re <= 0.135 (Andreas 1987)

name: cq1_mid_Re
description: coefficient 1 of the roughness length for moisture z_q over smooth surfaces for 0.135 < Re < 2.5 (Andreas 1987)

name: cq1_high_Re
description: coefficient 1 of the roughness length for moisture z_q over smooth surfaces for Re >= 2.5 (Andreas 1987)

name: cq2_low_Re
description: coefficient 2 of the roughness length for moisture z_q over smooth surfaces for Re <= 0.135 (Andreas 1987)

name: cq2_mid_Re
description: coefficient 2 of the roughness length for moisture z_q over smooth surfaces for 0.135 < Re < 2.5 (Andreas 1987)

name: cq2_high_Re
description: coefficient 2 of the roughness length for moisture z_q over smooth surfaces for Re >= 2.5 (Andreas 1987)

name: cq3_low_Re
description: coefficient 3 of the roughness length for moisture z_q over smooth surfaces for Re <= 0.135 (Andreas 1987)

name: cq3_mid_Re
description: coefficient 3 of the roughness length for moisture z_q over smooth surfaces for 0.135 < Re < 2.5 (Andreas 1987)

name: cq3_high_Re
description: coefficient 3 of the roughness length for moisture z_q over smooth surfaces for Re >= 2.5 (Andreas 1987)

name: R
description: universal gas constant

name: kappa_poisson
description: Poisson constant for dry air (R_d / c_pd)
